3. The committee shall be headed by its Chair-
man who shall be the executive officer of the com-
mittee, and will be empowered to appoint such
persons or entities and to issue such rules and
206
regulations for the purposes of assisting him in
the discharge of his duties and responsibilities
and of implementing the objectives and programs of
the committee.
4. The chairman is also authorized to call
directly upon any department, bureau, or office of
the executive branch of the government or upon any
government-owned or controlled entity or agency
for such assistance as the committee may need and,
subject to the approval of the President, to re-
quisition or utilize and make use of the services
of their personnel.
